action_input.sql:
SELECT
    m.r.first_name,
    m.r.last_name,
    SUM(e.r.cost) AS total_cost
FROM
    (SELECT unnest(records) AS r FROM read_json_auto('json/member.json')) AS m
JOIN
    (SELECT unnest(records) AS r FROM read_json_auto('json/expense.json')) AS e
ON
    m.r.member_id = e.r.link_to_member
WHERE
    m.r.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'
GROUP BY
    m.r.first_name, m.r.last_name;
